title: the_seed_that_finished_itself
beats: There's a parkour seed on my world that finishes itself if you leave it running long enough.
I built it three years ago for a video — sixty jumps, obsidian to obsidian, nothing special.
Last week I left my PC on overnight with the world loaded, no reason, just forgot.
I came back to a completed run in the replay log — full clear, perfect timing, no deaths.
I hadn't touched the keyboard. The launcher said I'd been offline the whole time.
I checked the player skin in the replay. It was mine, but the name tag above its head was blank.
I deleted the world. The file came back the next morning in my saves folder, same size, same timestamp as the original.
I opened it anyway, because I'm an idiot, and there was a new structure at the end of the course.
A single obsidian block, floating past the finish line, with my Xbox gamertag carved into the texture like scratch marks.
I haven't loaded that world since, but the file still shows 'last played: today' every single day.
Has anyone else's parkour map ever finished a run you didn't play?
